State 0 copies $1990,X and $197F,X to $1B06,X and $1B17,X, calls $71DB, and uses its returned X as a patched comparison threshold for $6F3C. It stores $00 or $08 at $1AD3,X according to that comparison, sets $1AB1,X to 1, stores the threshold minus 6 with a floor of zero at $1AE4,X, and jumps to $909C. The compare operand at $8F2A is patched at runtime. The dispatcher at $8EF0 (the vector for types $06 and $14) jumps here when state $1AB1,X is 0, the value state 4 stores at $904A and $447A leaves when the slot is set up.

Compare the value loaded from $6F3C with an immediate byte patched by STX $8F2A at $8F22 after $71DB returns: the entity’s tile column. The load holds $FF there. The branch at $8F2B uses the resulting carry.

Use the carry from the column comparison at $8F29 to choose $08 when set or $00 when clear, and store it at $1AD3,X. Set $1AB1,X to 1, subtract 6 from the threshold patched at $8F2A with a floor of zero, store that value at $1AE4,X and jump to the shared update at $909C.

State 1 returns immediately when $1A29,X is zero. Otherwise it checks that $6F3C is greater than $1AE4,X and no greater than that byte plus $0C, then subtracts $1A and the selected display-slot Y from $49. When those checks pass, it stores the resulting difference shifted right three bits at $1AE4,X and sets $1AB1,X to 2. The arithmetic is eight-bit and can wrap; the non-return paths jump to $909C. The dispatcher at $8EF0 (the vector for types $06 and $14) jumps here when state $1AB1,X is 1, which state 0 stores at $8F38.

State 2 calls $909C and decrements $1AE4,X. A negative result sets $1AB1,X to 3, $1AF5,X to 1 and $1AE4,X to 7. Otherwise it calls $4368 with A=$08, then calls $43A2 when $1AD3,X is zero or $43F0 when it is nonzero. The dispatcher at $8EF0 (the vector for types $06 and $14) jumps here when state $1AB1,X is 2, which state 1 stores at $8F76.

State 3 calls $909C and $4368, decrements $1AE4,X when nonzero, and increments $1AF5,X unless it equals 5. It calls $43A2 or $43F0 according to $1AD3,X, then compares a shifted display-slot position with $4DAE. On the qualifying side of that comparison, unless $1AB1,X already equals 4, it sets that state to 4, writes $52 or $5E to $1B28,X and toggles bit $08 in $1AD3,X. The dispatcher at $8EF0 (the vector for types $06 and $14) jumps here when state $1AB1,X is 3, which state 2 stores at $8F9C.

State 4 calls $909C and $35C1 with $1B28,X, then compares the 16-bit value $197F/$1990,X with the saved $1B17/$1B06,X using subtraction. If the subtraction borrows, it restores the saved two bytes and sets $1AB1,X to zero; otherwise it returns without that restoration. The dispatcher at $8EF0 (the vector for types $06 and $14) jumps here when state $1AB1,X is 4, which the turn at $9008 stores.
